manual.crafting_components.line2: Many machines and tools are constructed from various sub-components. Some of these you will have to use on a regular basis, detailed on the following pages.{0}
manual.crafting_components.line3: Simple components can be crafted in the regular §2Crafting Table§r, but advanced components will need the help of a {0}specialized workbench{1}.{2}
manual.crafting_components.line4: {0}The §2Basic Engineering Block§r serves as the main construction material for a large variety of machinery. It makes up a core frame for most single-block machinery, especially in matters of transportation and power storage.
manual.crafting_components.line5: {0}The §2Iron§r and §2Steel Mechanical Components§r are integral to the majority of machinery large and small.{1}
manual.crafting_components.line6: As you will find yourself creating these components more frequently, it may be advisable to draft a {0}Blueprint{1} for them.{2}
manual.crafting_components.line8: Instructions for drafting this blueprint can be found {0}here{1}.{2}
manual.crafting_components.line9: Using this blueprint in an {0}Engineer's Workbench{1} will allow you to construct simple components at a reduced cost.{2}
manual.crafting_components.line10: Blueprints are necessary for more advanced components, as detailed on the following pages.{0}
manual.crafting_components.line11: {0}§2Electronic Components§r are more complicated and less commonly used than their mechanical counterpart. They are however essential for any devices with an extended level of control such as the {1}Item Batcher{2} or {3}Turrets{4}.{5}
manual.crafting_components.line12: {0}§2Incandescent Light Bulbs§r are made of a carbonized bamboo or paper filament which produce light and warmth when powered. They are primarily used to craft {1}lanterns{2}.{3}
manual.crafting_components.line13: {0}Another, albeit less frequently used component are §2Vacuum Tubes§r. These expensive ingredients are used in {1}Logic Circuits{2} and more complex electronic machinery.{3}
manual.crafting_components.line14: {0}The §2Circuit Backplane§r is an insulated copper board that can have a variety of components soldered to it in order to create {1}Logic Circuits{2}.
